metadata.case_name: TSANG HO SANG v. SUNBASE ENVIRONMENTAL HYGIENE LTD

injuries.description: Head pain / head injury (soft tissue complaint)
source: He felt pain in his head, neck, lower back and buttocks.
landed on left shoulder and buttock, head injury …… headache over occipital region, left sided neck pain, left shoulder & left buttock pain
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of unspecified part of head

injuries.description: Neck injury with pain and stiffness
source: He felt pain in his head, neck, lower back and buttocks.
Examination revealed tenderness over left neck, left shoulder and left buttock.
Mid neck pain + stiffness on rotation to the left and right (sometimes) intermittently.
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain with musculoskeletal signs

injuries.description: Left-sided low back pain (lumbar / L-S region)
source: He felt pain in his head, neck, lower back and buttocks.
41. Left-sided low back pain, dull ache, continuous and nonstop and fluctuating when walking for more than 20 minutes he needs to rest.
Unable to squat with increased low back pain that increases with movement.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: Arm and left forearm numbness (sensory deficit)
source: 43. Arm + left forearm numbness continuously, ant-bit, fluctuating and increases when working at home, with increased numbness.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of cutaneous sensory nerve at forearm level

injuries.description: Pre-existing degenerative changes at the cervical spine
source: Both experts agreed that x-ray of Tsang’s cervical spine showed pre-existing degenerative changes not caused by the incident.

injuries.description: Pre-existing degenerative changes at the L-S spine
source: With the pre-existing degenerative changes at the cervical spine and at the L-S spine, there is a strong possibility that, in the absence of the alleged injury, some other event or the natural progression of the conditions, will lead to his neck pain and stiffness & intermittent low back pain… … occur at any time
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: Mid neck pain and stiffness on rotation
Left-sided low back pain, dull ache, continuous and fluctuating
Unable to squat with increased low back pain
Arm and left forearm numbness (continuous, fluctuating)
Impairments will persist and he will have on and off pain that requires treatment on a need-to basis in the future.

treatments_received.treatment: A&E examination and referral to Orthopaedics & Traumatology
source: Tsang was first sent to A&E and then referred to the O&T for treatment.
He was hospitalized for 1 day.
He also attended physiotherapy and occupational therapy sessions at PYNEH since February 2013.
He also attended physiotherapy and occupational therapy sessions at PYNEH since February 2013.

treatments_received.treatment: Discharge with home exercise and advice (10 July 2013)
source: He was discharged on 10 July 2013 with home exercise and advice.
Medical Assessment Board was done in December 2013 and he was granted 2% permanent disability.

losses.description: Unable to squat with increased low back pain; reduced movement of the back and low back pain on walking
Arm and left forearm numbness continuously, fluctuating and increasing with activity

comparable_cases.case_name: Tam Kwok Man v The Kowloon Motor Bus Company (1933) Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: The plaintiff suffered from minor contusion of the back due to a fall from a wheeled chair, reduced movement of the back, no permanent or structural damage and no operation required; doctors considered a period of 9 to 12 months sick leave suitable.
